videos.desc: In an elegant restaurant in the evening, a bearded man in a black shirt stands at the glass door and spreads his hands apologetically toward a young couple: a woman with braids in a burgundy blouse and black skirt, and a man in a cream jumper. The couple turn and walk away past him while he presses his hands together. Every table is set with white cloths, candles, water carafes and glasses. Waiters in white shirts work near a stack of plates, and round paper lanterns hang from the dark wooden ceiling.

In a busy street market at night under strings of lights, the pavement wet from rain, a young woman in an olive cycling top and shorts leans from her cargo bike and hands a wooden crate full of steaming fresh loaves toward a bread stall. She gets off the bike, carries the crate to the counter, sets it down and talks to the people in front of the stall, smiling. Wicker baskets, a chalkboard price list and a warm-lit counter stand at the stall, and a small crowd watches.

In a retro American diner a man in a denim jacket sits in a booth with high cream and burgundy padded bench backs around a chrome-edged table with plates of pancakes. A huge brindle Great Dane stands with its front paws on the table. A young waitress in a mint-green uniform and white apron, with a scarf in her dark ponytail, pours coffee from a steel pot into a cup, then pulls the pot back and looks on as the dog lowers its head and drinks from the cup. Men in the next booth watch and grin.

Inside an old wood-panelled train dining car with snowy pink mountains outside the windows, a young chef in a white jacket and grey neckerchief lifts a tall shiny metal ring off a round dessert on a white tablecloth: a cake walled with upright sponge fingers, topped with cream and raspberries and tied with a pink ribbon. A woman in a velvet top covers her mouth in surprise, a man in a dinner jacket stares and then smiles, and other diners watch from lamp-lit tables.

At an outdoor pepper-eating contest under a canvas awning on a sunny day, a young man in a white shirt and a red neckerchief holds a bunch of long red and green hot peppers above his head with a pepper in his mouth, then lowers his arm and keeps chewing. The wooden table in front of him is covered with boards of thin red peppers and a basket of green ones, and a string of dried peppers hangs above. Beside him another man pours water from a jug over his face while a referee and a crowd cheer.

At a rooftop bar at sunset with a city skyline and strings of bulbs overhead, a young woman bartender with a high ponytail and a black T-shirt pours soda into a tall ice-filled glass topped with a lemon slice, adds a red cherry and slides the drink across the marble bar to a man in a denim jacket. He takes it, grins and drinks through a straw. A metal shaker, a jigger, halved lemons, a plate of lemon slices and a bowl of cherries stand on the bar, and a crowd drinks behind.

In a wooden cabin dining hall lit by a hanging lamp, a big middle-aged man in a plaid shirt and braces hunches over a tin plate piled with beans, potatoes and a pork chop. A woman leans over and ladles more beans from a big pot onto his spoon, and he stuffs the spoonful into his mouth. Then he takes a big bite of a thick piece of bread. Other workers in caps eat at the long wooden table, beans lie scattered on the boards and a stack of empty plates waits beside him.

A flower market street on a damp morning. A young man in a white chef's jacket, a white apron and a white cap rides an old bicycle over the cobbles, balancing a big metal tray of round golden pastries filled with cherry and apricot high on one hand. A pigeon swoops down, grabs one pastry in its beak and flies off over his head while he looks up in surprise and keeps riding. Buckets of tulips and eucalyptus line the street, and a woman behind a stall laughs.

At a long wooden table in a vineyard at dusk, a woman in a straw hat and black vest lifts a huge steaming pan of seafood paella over the heads of farm workers in dusty work clothes and caps and sets it down in the middle of the table. The laughing workers reach out with their plates and start serving themselves, and she smiles and touches her hat. Bread, bowls of salad, cheese and grapes cover the table, string lights hang between olive trees, and a dog lies under the table.

At night at a busy street food stall full of steam and hanging light bulbs, a smiling young man in a grey bandana, white T-shirt and white apron pours golden potato fries from a wire frying basket into a white paper cone. He then turns and hands the full cone to a laughing man in the small crowd, who reaches out for it while the others cheer. Steel deep fryers stand on the counter, with more fries in a tray and spilled from a metal cup.

A young man in a backwards red cap and a white tank top stands at a long table at a hot dog eating contest on a sunny seaside boardwalk under strings of colourful flags. He throws his head back and pumps his fist in the air as he swallows a hot dog. A young woman beside him holds a cup and a jug of water, a referee in a striped shirt stands nearby, and another contestant in a blue tank top sits at the table. Trays of hot dogs, bowls of water and sauce bottles cover the table, and a big crowd cheers with raised arms behind.

A smiling young woman in an orange helmet and orange jacket glides past a small wooden coffee hut with a striped awning on a mountain ridge at sunrise, hanging in her paraglider harness under a wide wing. She takes a paper coffee cup from a bearded man leaning out of the hut, where a coffee machine steams, and flies on holding the cup. She passes cheering hikers and a jumping dog on the rocky path and glides away over a sea of pink clouds, with other paragliders drifting in the distance.

At a dinner in a white-walled courtyard at dusk, under strings of lights, pink bougainvillea and lemon trees in pots, a laughing young woman in a linen apron leans over a long wooden table and lifts a big spoonful of yellow seafood rice with prawns from a wide pan onto a man's plate. He raises his hands happily, she serves more and then stands back laughing. Friends around the table laugh, and there are plates of rice, a salad bowl, a water jug, lemon wedges and candles in jars.

At night a young man in a brown beanie, olive puffer jacket and hoodie with a lanyard sits on a low wall beside a lit takeaway van. He holds a handful of chips over a greasy paper wrapper of chips, ketchup and a battered sausage on his lap and eats them. He turns to look at a seagull that stands on the wall beside him, drinks from a can and smiles. A cheeseburger in paper sits next to him on the wall, steam rises from the van's fryer and orange street lights shine on the wet pavement behind.

Under a thatched palm roof at an outdoor distillery in warm late sun, a young woman with her dark hair tied back, in an olive shirt and a stained canvas apron, holds a round gourd high above her head and pours a thin stream of clear spirit into a small cup-shaped gourd in her other hand. Then she lowers the full cup, lifts it to her face and smells the foamy liquor with a serious look. Behind her stand a copper still with a coiled copper pipe, a glass jug, a wooden vat of mash and a man working.

A small, simple dockside cafe on a grey morning. A woman behind the counter pours tea from one white enamel mug into another next to a steel water urn, while bacon sizzles and steams on a griddle behind her. A bearded man in a brown work jacket and a yellow hi-vis vest steps up to the counter, picks up a pen and leans over a newspaper crossword. Mugs hang on hooks under a price board, another worker in a beanie waits behind, and cranes stand outside the window.

In an old stone barn at dusk, lit by lanterns, a young woman in a cream cable-knit jumper, a leather apron and green rubber boots laughs as she pulls open the wooden tap of a big barrel. A pale golden, fizzy drink gushes out in a thick stream into a wooden tub, which fills with froth and overflows onto the floor. Crates of green pears stand nearby and bunches of pears hang from the beams. Friends at the open door to the orchard cheer, and a dog lies on the floor.

In a busy indoor fish market under a high iron roof, a young woman with a ponytail, a white T-shirt, a black waterproof apron and yellow rubber boots tosses a whole silver salmon high into the air with one hand. The salmon flies up and across the market, and a man further back catches it. Behind her another fishmonger raises both hands. White boxes of fish and mussels on ice fill the front, a tabby cat sits on a stack of crates, and older shoppers in winter coats watch.

In an animated vaulted brick cheese cellar lit by a hanging lantern, three mice in aprons look after rows of big round cheese wheels stored on long wooden shelves. One mouse in a flat cap pushes a heavy old wheel with a rough crust along a shelf, another in a green waistcoat stands on the shelf above, and a third climbs up a ladder holding a brush and steps onto the shelf. A wooden bucket stands on the stone floor and snow lies against the small barred window.

A street-food market at night lit by paper lanterns under brick arches. A young woman in a black leather jacket takes a big bite of a folded taco, eyes shut and head tilted back with pleasure, and keeps chewing happily. Two friends beside her bite into their own tacos. Small bowls of red and green salsa and lime wedges stand on the long wooden table, and behind them a cook in a red cap turns tortillas on a hot griddle at a stall, then folds his arms.

A cosy living room at night with fairy lights and a snowy window. A delivery man in a red jacket and bike helmet comes through the front door carrying an enormous stack of pizza boxes taller than himself and looks up at it nervously. The view widens: a young woman in a mustard jumper laughs with her hand on her head, friends on the sofa and by the window eat slices of pizza, open pizzas cover the coffee table, more boxes are piled up, and a golden retriever eats a whole pizza from a box on the floor.

A bright café with round paper lamps, big windows and a wooden counter. A young female barista in a black apron, laughing and waving one hand, pours milk from a steel jug but misses the cup, so the milk floods across the counter and runs down its front. A grey cat leaps off the wet counter in fright, and a young man in a brown apron leans over and wipes up the mess with a cloth. A customer in a lilac jumper watches in the foreground, and people sit and stand behind.

A rooftop party at dusk under strings of light bulbs. A grinning young man in a patterned shirt pours water from a big clear bottle held high into a glass jug of orange juice, while a friend beside him pours in juice from a carton, so the jug ends up about half juice and half water. He then lowers the bottle and laughs. Other friends laugh, gasp and grab each other's arms. On the folding table are lemons, a bowl of ice, plastic cups, a cool box and a glass of juice.

Friends sitting on a rug on a city rooftop at sunset. Five young people each pull a slice of pepperoni pizza away from a large open pizza box, with melted cheese stretching, and start eating and laughing. Most of the box is empty and greasy, and only a small part of the pizza is left in it. Hands in lilac sleeves hold the box in the foreground and then take one of the last slices too. Drinks stand on a wooden crate, and chimneys, roofs and string lights fill the background.

A bakery with dark green walls and brass lamps in the evening. A golden retriever in a baker's hat and apron stands behind the glass counter holding a wooden peel with a paper bag and croissants on it. It tips the peel up too far, the croissants tumble out onto the counter and one lands on a baking tray, then it raises the peel with the bag and grins with its mouth open. Apart from that, the metal trays hold only crumbs and pale marks. Street lamps and old buildings are seen through the window, and a wicker basket hangs on the wall.

A bakery doorway on an autumn street. A young woman in a lilac sports jacket and black leggings leans hard towards a tall chocolate layer cake on a marble stand of pastries and fruit tarts, her eyes fixed on it. A young man in a navy T-shirt holds her arm and pulls her back towards the street while she keeps straining forward. A baker in a white jacket behind the counter holds out a slice, and a woman in a yellow coat laughs outside next to a café awning.

A sushi bar with paper lanterns and a light wooden counter. In front of a laughing young woman in a pink cardigan stand two very tall stacks of empty coloured sushi plates. Behind the counter a young chef in a navy jacket and white headband leans over and points along the taller stack, counting the plates with an amazed face. The young woman waves her hands, then hides her face in her hand, laughing. Small plates of sushi, a cup of tea, chopsticks and a dish of ginger sit on the counter.
